summary: True Protein is a Sydney northern beaches sports nutrition manufacturer on NetSuite and Shopify, selling through three channels. CFO and COO Lachie Cornwell has publicly called reconciliations, journals and month-end close repetitive; Head of Finance Amy Knoll leads process and automation; the close has already fallen to two or three days and a hybrid in-house/outsourced model is in place.

sources.title: From Bean Counters to Business Partners to Business Avengers!

claims.text: True Protein was founded in 2014, makes its products itself and operates three warehouse locations on Sydney's northern beaches.
claims.quote: True Protein was founded in 2014 by Ben Kierath, who started making products in his kitchen.

claims.text: Lachie (Lachlan) Cornwell is Chief Financial and Operations Officer at True Protein.
claims.quote: Lachie Cornwell, Chief Financial and Operations Officer at True Protein

claims.text: CFO Magazine's Feb 2026 profile of Lachie Cornwell calls reconciliations, journals, data entry and month-end close repetitive and uninspiring.
claims.quote: Reconciliations, journals, data entry, month-end close – it’s important, sure. But it’s also repetitive and uninspiring.

claims.text: Cornwell said 80% of the local finance team's time had gone on repetitive, scalable tasks.
claims.quote: 80% of our local, highly skilled finance team was dedicating their time to repetitive, scalable tasks.

claims.text: Cornwell credits Head of Finance Amy Knoll with the process discipline and automation knowledge critical for the future.
claims.quote: Amy has the process discipline and the knowledge of automation that I think are going to be critical for the future

claims.text: Cornwell says integrated automation and AI tools let the finance team spot issues before month-end.
claims.quote: spot issues before month-end and come to leadership with solutions

claims.text: True Protein put the NetSuite AI Connector into production in early 2026.
claims.quote: True Protein put Oracle's NetSuite AI Connector into production in early 2026

claims.text: iTWire reports True Protein's month-end close went from 10 days to 2 or 3 days.
claims.quote: True Protein's month-end financial close went from 10 days down to 2 or 3.

claims.text: True Protein runs three sales channels: two on Shopify (wholesale and direct-to-consumer) and one on NetSuite directly (FMCG).
claims.quote: True Protein runs 3 sales channels: 2 on Shopify (wholesale and direct-to-consumer) and one on NetSuite directly (FMCG).

claims.text: True Protein outsources transactional finance work to Business Avengers in a hybrid in-house/outsourced model.
claims.quote: the team started outsourcing its heavy lifting to Business Avengers

claims.text: True Protein is relocating to a new facility and building a second facility in Melbourne for a new product line.
claims.quote: True Protein is relocating to a new facility at the end of the year and building a second facility in Melbourne for a new product line.

claims.text: True Protein centralised its operations on NetSuite (financials, inventory, WMS, CRM, planning, manufacturing).
claims.quote: True Protein centralised its operations on NetSuite

hooks.text: The CFO publicly named reconciliations, journals and close as repetitive and said 80% of local finance time went on repetitive tasks.
Amy Knoll leads process discipline and automation; three sales channels feed NetSuite.
